name: Howard Hughes Medical Institute International Student Research Fellowship
amount: Annual stipend of $43,000, plus an educational allowance for three years which is applied to tuition.
notes: Requires Faculty/Administration nomination **Will not have competition in 2017** This fellowship program supports outstanding international predoctoral students studying in the United States who are ineligible for fellowships or training grants through U.S. federal agencies. Participation is by invitation only. Nominated students must be in their second or third year of study to apply for the fellowship. To activate the fellowship, students must be in the third or fourth year of a PhD program at one of the designated institutions. Not yet checked against the funder's page; details may have changed.
